display.purpose: The one page heading. Drops to 2rem on a phone.

headline.purpose: Section headings and dialog titles. Also the brand name and the numbers in store facts.

lead.purpose: The one sentence under the page heading.

title.purpose: Sub-headings, field labels, button text and store names in rows.

body.purpose: Row content, inputs and dialog text.

label.purpose: Second lines in a row, hints, footnotes and the user line in the top bar.

data.purpose: Device IDs and other machine strings. The one-time password sets it larger and bold at 1.125rem so it can be read out.

shadows.name: check-mark-inset
shadows.purpose: Draws the white gap inside a ticked box. Not elevation.

motion.name: instant
motion.purpose: No transitions or animation. Every state change is one step.

narrative.overview:
The dashboard is a plain black-and-white report that a reviewer marks in red. It has no sidebar, no stat tiles and no soft cards. Pages read from the top down: a large heading, one sentence that says what is waiting, then full-width rows with the action at the end of each row.

Colour is a debt of attention. Red appears only where a person has to act or where an action destroys something, so clearing the queue removes the red from the Tasks screen. Everything else is black text on white, separated by thin rules. The page changes in instant steps, the way a marked sheet is replaced by a cleaner one.

The density is that of a working document: short rows, plain words for state, and underlined links. The layout is Arabic first and right to left, and a phone can finish every task a laptop can.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, black Tajawal, one red.
Thin rules and square corners instead of cards and shadows.
State is a plain word, and red only when it needs a person.
Selected means inverted to a black bar.

rules.name: The Debt of Attention Rule
rules.body: Red means a person must act, or the action destroys something. It never decorates. At zero tasks the Tasks screen carries no red at all. Destructive buttons on a store's settings stay red, because they warn about the action and do not report a debt.

rules.name: The Weight Is Severity Rule
rules.body: Bold red is due now: a waiting task, an ended subscription, a form error. Regular red is coming soon or secondary: a subscription about to end, a device limit that is full.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Only regular (400) and bold (700) exist. Those are the two weights that ship, and synthetic bold is turned off.

rules.name: The Joined Script Rule
rules.body: No letter spacing and no uppercase styling. Arabic letters join, and spacing breaks them apart.

rules.name: The Machine String Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for strings a machine made: IDs, keys, passwords. It never sets a heading or a sentence.

rules.name: The Priority Drop Rule
rules.body: On a phone a table drops its lowest-priority columns and, where the reader still needs them, folds those values into a small line under the row's main cell. State and action stay.

rules.name: The Store Number Rule
rules.body: A store is shown with its number wherever it appears in a queue or list.

rules.name: The Logical Edge Rule
rules.body: Every margin, padding, border and alignment uses a logical property (start and end, not left and right), so right to left is correct by construction. Latin strings such as emails and usernames are isolated with their own direction.

rules.name: The No Cast Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface is separated by a rule or by inversion, never by a shadow beneath it.

rules.name: The Instant Step Rule
rules.body: There are no transitions and no animation. Hover, selection, disclosure and row removal all happen in one step.

rules.name: The Square Rule
rules.body: No rounded corners on anything, including inputs and focus rings.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: Selected is an inverted black bar and nothing else. No underline tab, no tinted pill, no accent colour.

rules.name: The Must Not Miss Rule
rules.body: A solid block is reserved for what a person must not miss. Only the one-time secret takes a solid band in the page.

dos: Do use #c4161c as the only accent, and only for something a person must act on or an action that destroys.
Do make the primary button solid ink, and keep red buttons for destructive actions.
Do write state as a plain word in the row's text.
Do underline links, and thicken the underline to 2px on hover.
Do invert to a black bar to show what is selected.
Do keep text contrast at 4.5:1 or better, and keep the 2px focus outline visible on every background.
Do use logical properties for every edge.
Do put the action at the end of the row, and keep it there on a phone.
donts: Don't use the Android app's green, or add a second accent.
Don't add cards, chips or rounded corners.
Don't cast a shadow under anything.
Don't put a tinted panel behind content. The Row Tint is for table row hover only.
Don't add a transition or an animation.
Don't add icons where a word works. The drawn disclosure arrow is the only one the build needs.
Don't add a sidebar or a row of stat tiles.
Don't add letter spacing or uppercase styling.
Don't add a font weight other than 400 or 700.
